decisions.reason: Operator training is a low-cost service tied to the firm's core machines and customer support model, so it stays useful whatever the specific product mix.
A fourth rotary axis is a standard accessory that extends the core milling machines and supports their sales at little added cost.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core business and was only mentioned on the website, which makes it the most likely to be cut, but it fits the firm's stated push into future-oriented materials processing, so it is kept for now.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the core business and had its own page, so it is likely a central revenue product.
Automatic tool change systems are integral to efficient machining workflows and build directly on the firm's established offer.
